description: Owner only: everything the shop holds as one ZIP: data/<table>.csv and data/<table>.json for every shop table, files/ with job photos (and the original HEIC or TIFF file next to its JPEG copy) and PDFs, and manifest.json. Signing secrets and token hashes are left out. By default you get download_url, a link that works for 60 minutes and up to 5 downloads; anyone with the link can download, so do not share it. delivery "inline" returns zip_base64 instead, only for exports up to 10 MB. Large shops: pass include_files false for data only.

delivery.description: link (default): a short-lived download_url. inline: zip_base64 in the response, up to 10 MB.

link_minutes.description: How long the download link works. Default 60.

name: shops_export
